Blake Barnett never did steer far from the spotlight as a dual-threat quarterback at Erie High School. His tenacity and improvisation bordered on reckless, scaring the daylights out of his coaches. Frankly, that's what made him marvelous. Barnett became Colorado's 11-man career touchdown leader in the fall of 2023 before leading the Tigers to the Class 4A state championship. He engineered the final scoring drive of his career on an injured leg as Erie defeated Palmer Ridge for the title. He left CSU's Canvas Stadium the only way he knew how — triumphant and on one leg, like a gladiator taking his final bow. Will that version of Barnett return? Since taking his final snap at Erie, Barnett has been trying to prove he can be "the guy" at Kansas State. He redshirted in 2024 before serving as starting quarterback Avery Johnson's backup last fall. Barnett appeared in four games and was primarily used for his running ability, rushing 14 times for 40 yards. Johnson is expected to return as the Wildcats' starter in 2026 under coach Collin Klein, a Loveland High School graduate, and could potentially return for a fifth season in 2027 if he chooses. That doesn't provide the clearest path for Barnett to become the starter anytime soon, but he remains optimistic. "Things are going great out here," Barnett told BoCoPreps.com. "The goal this year is to just be my best self every day and play some meaningful snaps." Although Klein hasn't named Johnson's backup, Barnett is approaching the season with the intention of proving he's the Wildcats' quarterback of the future. "I'm hoping I can get in and play with full access to the offense and show what I can do with my arm," Barnett said. "If that's this year or next year, I'll be ready to help the Cats win." John Pastore, who played alongside Barnett at Erie and was named to the Preseason All-Big 12 Team as an offensive lineman earlier this week, is backing his longtime friend. XXX Though it wasn't recognized as an official CHSAA record at the time, Barnett surpassed Christian McCaffrey's career touchdown record in 2023 (including passing touchdowns).
